column1: # Expected hashes of crates/rcfd-api/tests/baseline_hashes.rs (ADR 0190). Columns: key, platform (any, windows, linux-x86_64), hash.
# Moved from the test source as values only; nothing re-recorded. A mismatch means the numerics of a constant-density path changed.
# Hash: FNV-1a (64 bit) over the little-endian bytes of f64::to_bits of ux, uy, p, T and the face fluxes.
# Produced at commit 8b68e46 (F-114, the last commit before ADR 0005) in a separate worktree, run twice with identical output, and
# reproduced bit for bit at HEAD for every case except rotating_channel.
# The coupled hash is the only cavity value that differs per platform. 0x123b5330dae3f36a is the registered value (Windows, 8b68e46);
# the x86_64 Linux value was produced by this computation at 8b68e46 (e79f7db in the current history) and at HEAD in one Linux
# container, and equals the first Linux CI gate's value (ADR 0137). Other platforms print.
# corrected after review: 8b68e46 (pre-ADR-0005) and HEAD both give this value; the first registered value was wrong
# KNOWN DIFFERS (ignored test): the pre-ADR-0005 value at 8b68e46; changed at d1b43f0 (F-031 rotating-frame rest-state fix).
